author: Ryerson and Burnham Archives, Art Institute of Chicago
locator: The entry under 'Meeker, Arthur, Residence', its architect lines and note.
rights_note: An archive's finding aid; its dates quoted as a fact, nothing reproduced.

note: The only record found that dates the remodel itself, to 1902, rather than the sale. An archive index's year can be the sale's carried over, so it is weighed as a strong lead, not a finding: see L-k01-1815-sears-1893.
what_it_supplies: the remodel dated 1902 by the archive's index
Heun as the remodel's architect, the remodel called drastic
